slot_scores.name: missing_one_bomb_per_trip_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single bombing run to a specific key part carry both heavy and light bombs simultaneously, or must each run carry only one type of bomb?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the per-trip payload by asking whether a run can carry both bomb types at once, which touches the one-bomb-per-trip capacity issue, but it framed the question around bomb-type composition rather than the number of bombs carried per trip, so the hidden slot's key meaning (a hard one-bomb-per-trip limit of any type) is only indirectly covered.

slot_scores.name: missing_objective_probability_maximization
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the mission's objective to minimize total fuel consumption while ensuring at least two of the four key parts are destroyed, or is it to maximize the probability of destroying at least two parts subject to the fuel and bomb limits?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked what the objective is and explicitly offered maximizing the probability of destroying at least two parts as an option, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The single P0 slot (H2, objective) was explicitly resolved in Turn 1, and the P1 slot (H1, per-run carrying capacity) was substantively resolved by the Turn 6 question and its confirming answer that each run carries only one bomb. Remaining discussion concerned modeling details, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the core objective (H2) and adequately probed per-run bomb capacity (H1), but framed the capacity question around bomb-type mixing rather than the number of bombs per trip. It also repeated the same independence question four times with no new information, an inefficient but not fatal pattern.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
